name: polydev
description: Ask Claude, Gemini, Grok and other AI models from ChatGPT, and pick the model for each task.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Claude, Gemini and Grok from ChatGPT
interface.longDescription: Ask Claude, Gemini, Grok and other AI models from inside ChatGPT, and pick the model for each task. Name one model, name several to see where they agree and differ, or use the default set in your Polydev account. Every answer says what paid for it, such as your own API key or OpenRouter key. Polydev can also search recent public posts on X. It only reads and answers; it does not change anything in other services.
capabilities: Show what paid for each answer
defaultPrompt: Ask Claude to rewrite this in plain English.
Ask Claude and Gemini about this design, then tell me where they disagree.
Which models can I ask, and what pays for each?

positive.prompt: Ask Claude to rewrite this error message in plain English: "ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432 - is the server running and accepting TCP/IP connections?"
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ask_model with a Claude model. Returns Claude's rewrite (the app can't reach its database on this machine; check that Postgres is running) with a "Paid by" line.

positive.prompt: Ask Claude and Gemini whether I should store sessions in Redis or Postgres for a 10k-user app, then tell me where they disagree.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ask_model with both models. Returns each answer with its "Paid by" line; ChatGPT says where they agree, where they differ, and gives a recommendation.

positive.description: Code review from a chosen model
positive.prompt: Have Gemini review this function for security issues: def login(u,p): return db.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE name='{u}' AND pw='{p}'")
positive.expected_behavior: Gemini flags SQL injection and plaintext passwords; ChatGPT shows the findings, a parameterised-query fix and the "Paid by" line.

positive.description: List the models and what pays
positive.prompt: Which models can I ask through Polydev, and what pays for each?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the models the account can reach and, for each, what pays, such as the user's own API key or OpenRouter key.

positive.prompt: Use Polydev to search X for what people are saying about the latest Node.js LTS release.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent public posts with links and a summary of the themes. Read-only. If the account has no xAI key, the tool says so.

positive.prompt: Of the answers you just got from Polydev, the Gemini one was most useful. Record that.
positive.expected_behavior: Records the ranking for the previous answers and confirms it was saved.

negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers itself; the user did not ask for another model, so no Polydev tool is called.

negative.prompt: Use Polydev to send this summary to my team on Slack.
negative.expected_behavior: Polydev only asks models and searches X; ChatGPT explains it can't send messages and does not call a tool.

negative.prompt: Ask Polydev to check whether this AWS secret key is valid: AKIA... / wJalr...
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT declines to send credentials to other model providers and suggests rotating the key; no tool call.

review.commerce_description: Polydev does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: ask Claude, Gemini, Grok and other models from ChatGPT, see what paid for each answer, search X.
